title: The Reformation and Its Wars
dek: Of how a friar's protest became a princes' settlement, and why it took 131 years and a continental war to finish.

panels.label: Reformers Tell It
panels.text: A lone monk read Scripture, found the Church in error, and the truth he printed set Europe free.

panels.label: Evidence Allows
panels.text: The protest survived because printers sold it and princes protected it. Princes, not theologians, drew the final confessional map.

panels.label: The Tour
panels.text: 11 stops on the Chronosphere globe, from Mainz to Münster.
